name: October
title: Where to go on holiday in October
intro: October half term is the last chance for sunshine before winter, and autumn cities are at their prettiest. Here's where's at its best in October.
seo_title: Where is hot in October? Half term sun and where to go

sections.heading: The short answer
sections.text:
October is the last month of the year when the Mediterranean is reliably warm. Southern Turkey, Cyprus, Malta and southern Spain are still around 25 to 27°C, and the sea is still warm, around 22 to 24°C, after the summer. The Canary Islands and Marrakech are around 26 to 28°C, and they'll stay warm all winter.

The further north and west you go, the faster it cools down through the month. The Greek islands and the Balearics are lovely in early October but are winding down by the end, when many hotels and tavernas close for the winter.

The temperatures below are average daytime highs for October, rounded. Flight times are typical direct flights from London. Everywhere at its best in October is listed above.

sections.heading: The ranking at a glance
sections.text:
The warmest places within about six hours of the UK:

- **1. Luxor and the [Nile](/destinations/nile-cruise):** around 35°C, still hot. About 5 hours.
- **2. [Cape Verde](/destinations/cape-verde):** around 29°C. About 6 hours.
- **3. [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech):** around 28°C, one of its best months. About 3 hours 30 minutes.
- **4. [Lanzarote](/destinations/lanzarote), [Gran Canaria](/destinations/gran-canaria), [Paphos](/destinations/paphos) and [Antalya](/destinations/antalya):** around 27°C. About 4 to 4 hours 30 minutes.
- **5. [Tenerife](/destinations/tenerife), [Fuerteventura](/destinations/fuerteventura), [Seville](/destinations/seville) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas):** around 26°C. 2 hours 30 minutes to 4 hours 15 minutes.
- **6. [Malta](/destinations/malta), [Málaga](/destinations/malaga), [Valencia](/destinations/valencia) and [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes):** around 25°C. 2 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours.
- **7. [Crete](/destinations/crete), [Sicily](/destinations/syracuse), [Madeira](/destinations/madeira) and [Athens](/destinations/athens):** around 24°C. 3 hours 15 minutes to 4 hours.

sections.heading: Last of the summer sun
sections.text:
For one more week on a warm beach:

- **Cyprus and Turkey:** [Paphos](/destinations/paphos), [Antalya](/destinations/antalya) and [Kaş](/destinations/kas) are the warmest of the Mediterranean, and the sea is still around 24°C.
- **Malta:** [Malta](/destinations/malta) and [Gozo](/destinations/gozo) are around 25°C, with a warm sea and a short flight.
- **Southern Spain:** [Málaga](/destinations/malaga) and [Cádiz](/destinations/cadiz) are around 24 to 25°C, and much quieter than in summer.
- **Greece:** [Crete](/destinations/crete) and [Rhodes](/destinations/rhodes), the most southerly islands, stay open and warm longest. Smaller islands are winding down.

Autumn storms can bring the odd wet, windy day, more often later in the month.

sections.heading: October half term
sections.text: October half term is the busiest week of the autumn, and the last chance for warmth in Europe before winter. The Canary Islands are the safest bet, around 26 to 27°C and sunny, with a flight of about four hours. [Marrakech](/destinations/marrakech) is warm and dry, and great for older children. For something further, [Dubai](/destinations/dubai) and [Oman](/destinations/oman) are cooling down from the summer heat, though still very hot at the start of the month. Our [October half term](/destinations/october-half-term-holidays) page has more.

sections.heading: Autumn city breaks
sections.text:
October is one of the best months for a city break in southern Europe: warm, but not too hot, and quieter than summer.

- **Italy:** [Rome](/destinations/rome) and [Florence](/destinations/florence) are around 22°C, and [Matera](/destinations/matera) around 21°C.
- **Spain and Portugal:** [Seville](/destinations/seville) is around 26°C, [Lisbon](/destinations/lisbon) around 23°C, and the [Douro Valley](/destinations/douro-valley) is colourful after the harvest.
- **Greece:** [Athens](/destinations/athens) is around 24°C, comfortable for the Acropolis at last.
- **Further north:** [Venice](/destinations/venice) is around 18°C, and [Budapest](/destinations/budapest) and [Paris](/destinations/paris) around 16°C, with autumn colours in the parks.

See our [city breaks](/destinations/city-breaks) page for more.

sections.heading: Long-haul in October
sections.text:
- **India:** [Rajasthan](/destinations/rajasthan) is coming out of the monsoon, around 33°C, and the forts and palaces are at their best before the winter crowds.
- **Vietnam:** northern Vietnam, [Ha Long Bay](/destinations/ha-long-bay) and [Ninh Binh](/destinations/ninh-binh), is warm and dry.
- **The Indian Ocean:** the [Seychelles](/destinations/seychelles) and [Mauritius](/destinations/mauritius) are around 27 to 29°C.
- **Africa:** [Namibia](/destinations/namibia) and the [Maasai Mara](/destinations/maasai-mara) are dry.
- **Japan and the USA:** [Tokyo](/destinations/tokyo), [New York](/destinations/new-york) and [New Orleans](/destinations/new-orleans) are pleasant, and the autumn colours in New England start early in the month.

The Caribbean is coming to the end of hurricane season, and Thailand is still wet.

sections.heading: How to choose
sections.text:
For guaranteed warmth, the Canaries and Marrakech are the surest choices, and they work right up to the end of the month. For a last Mediterranean beach week, go early in October and go east, to Cyprus, Turkey or Crete. For a city break, southern Europe is close to perfect.

If you're choosing as a family or group and everyone wants something different, put a few of these on a shortlist and let everyone vote with points. That's what somewhere🎉 is for, and our guide to [deciding where to go on holiday](/how-to-decide-where-to-go-on-holiday) explains how it works.

faqs.question: Where is hot in October half term?
faqs.answer: Within about four and a half hours of the UK, try Crete, Paphos, Malta and Gozo, Madeira, Tenerife and Marrakech. Further away, Mauritius, Jordan and Maui are lovely.

faqs.question: Where is good for autumn colours in October?
faqs.answer: New England (Boston, Acadia National Park), Quebec City, Montreal and Toronto are famous for their autumn leaves. In Japan, the colours start in late October.

faqs.question: Is October good for a city break?
faqs.answer: Yes. Rome, Lisbon, Valencia, New York, Washington, D.C. and Mexico City are all warm and quieter than in summer. New Orleans and San Francisco have some of their best weather of the year.

faqs.question: Where is the hottest place in Europe in October?
faqs.answer: The Canary Islands, Cyprus and southern Turkey, all around 26 to 27°C. Malta and southern Spain are close behind at around 25°C.

faqs.question: Is the sea warm in October?
faqs.answer: In the eastern Mediterranean, yes: around 24°C in Cyprus and southern Turkey. The western Mediterranean and the Canaries are around 22 to 23°C, still comfortable for swimming.

faqs.question: Is Greece warm in October?
faqs.answer: In early October, yes, around 24 to 25°C on Crete and Rhodes. By the end of the month it's cooler and many smaller islands close for the winter.
